::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 15th 1887  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

My dear [Nina](people/person_2352.qmd)[^1]

[Gertrude](people/person_1462.qmd) desires me to say that we have never had an American edition of [the Three Brides](cmy_books/cmybook_120.qmd) but she has taken measures for getting a second hand one and it will be sent to you. All my stories in the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) do get published again	Gertrude is tolerably well just now

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Identified tentatively from the letter of 2 June 1883.
